tests.title: MMS-01: one long word in a brief field (a German compound item title) makes the generated page scroll sideways at 390 px
MMS-02: the history review table says 'not recorded' for overflow, keyboard and reduced motion although review.json records them
MMS-03: 'Next: <step>' moves keyboard focus to a heading that is scrolled thousands of pixels out of view
MMS-04: the announcement line renders on Studio and Shopfront pages but its field is offered only for Launch
MMS-06: where the stage is shown first (768 px), its controls come after the whole control column in tab order
MMS-07: studio controls are 36 to 41 px tall on the 390 px touch layout, below the 44 px the design contract promises
MMS-08: segmented control groups (buttons, surfaces, corners, header, mode, template, device) have no visible label
MMS-09: a malformed deep link (#/history/%E0) throws in the router and blanks the whole site
MMS-10: the 'Still' preset says nothing moves on press, but the button still jumps and shrinks when pressed
MMS-16: at 1100 px and below the history run list scrolls (overflow auto) and clips the run link's focus ring on three sides
held: preview and history frames are opaque-origin sandboxes; preview scripts cannot reach the studio, storage or the network
held: hostile palettes render every visible text, hover, edge and focus pairing at or above WCAG minimums, light and dark
held: reduced motion means no animation in the studio, in the preview for such visitors, and in the reduced-motion preview
held: every focusable studio control shows a visible, unobscured focus indicator; the file import opens by keyboard
studio: stage shows the composed page in a sandboxed frame; accessible, no overflow
held: generated pages at 390 px keep every link and question at least 44 x 44 px with no sideways scroll (example content)
brief: editing a field updates the preview; a bad link is explained beside its field
